title: PAR-144 BLOCK_RECORD-to-LAYOUT byte-backed link fast slice

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: Broadly modified and uncommitted; no files staged.
localScope.change: The six-version selector captures actual emitted LINE and VIEWPORT frames, BLOCK_RECORD/LAYOUT frames, and following sentinels. Child owner/self-handle receipts are decoded against serialized child frames; AC1015 first/last references and AC1018+ hard-owned references/count resolve to actual captured child handles. The expanded generated probe emits two distinct LAYOUT/BLOCK_RECORD groups, each owning two actual VIEWPORT frames, in one writer stream. For both groups it resolves the BLOCK_RECORD→LAYOUT hard pointer and LAYOUT last-active/list references to actual frames, verifies exact owner references, rejects cross-layout handle references, and checks per-group frame CRCs/adjacency through sentinels. AC1015 validates last-active references and the no-list profile. Its common entity header confirms nolinks=1; the writer profile has no previous/next chain to traverse.

validation.result: PASS: DWG BLOCK_RECORD LAYOUT association controls

evidenceCeiling: Generated writer bytes plus test-local bounded frame/token decoders and writer receipts. The selector resolves two generated LAYOUT/BLOCK_RECORD/VIEWPORT groups to actual captured frames and rejects cross-layout handle references. AC1015 checks endpoint references and nolinks=1; it does not claim a linked-chain traversal. This is not an independent DWG reader, native CAD acceptance, or general multi-layout qualification.
